sources.summary: Imagine a corridor. Concrete walls two meters apart, a low ceiling, artificial lighting with neither shadow nor gradation. At the far end, a bulletproof glass window, and on the other side, a uniformed officer. You are at a port of entry . It could be in Calais , El Paso , or Lampedusa. An anonymous space , yet far from neutral . Designed so that anyone can understand: passage is not a right; it is a concession.
